To discover the 'magic of racing' and 
become a great witch like her 
grandmother—that is Sweep Tosho's goal.

Her run, brimming with sheer talent, was 
so overwhelming it felt like genuine 
magic.

However, with her selfish personality, she 
treated her Trainer like a "familiar" and 
led everyone on a wild ride right from the 
very start of their first training 
session.

The days of tackling the Twinkle Series 
with a selfish magical girl who works her 
familiar to the bone begin!
